subject: Request: Cohort promotional top-up / pricing sweetener for BrightLabs
messages:
From: Maria Chen <maria@brightlabs.org>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: sam.w@brightlabs.org
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: BrightLabs cohort ask — additional credits / pricing sweetener

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks again for the intro call last week — the founders on our autumn cohort were impressed by Redwood's latency and the dedicated private options. A few companies asked whether BrightLabs can secure an additional $3k promo top-up per team as a cohort "sweetener" and / or an upgraded trial bundle that includes (1) 50k embedding units and (2) a 100k token generation credit.

Our standard practice is to request promotional exceptions for select partners and we can handle the legal paperwork, but before we send over anything I wanted to check feasibility and whether you have internal guardrails for accelerator bundles and one-off credit add-ons. If there's a standard way you package this (SOW, promo code, or demo credits attached to an org) please point me there.

We would need pricing/credit confirmation by next Thursday (8/27) to circulate to founders.

Thanks — Maria

--
Maria Chen
Partnerships Director, BrightLabs Accelerator
maria@brightlabs.org
+1 415-555-0193

Attachment: BrightLabs_SOW_v1.pdf (application + cohort list)
From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Maria Chen <maria@brightlabs.org>
Cc: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: BrightLabs cohort ask — additional credits / pricing sweetener

Hi Maria — great to hear the cohort liked the product. Short answer: possible, yes. We have three common options for partner promos:

- One-time credit top-up tied to a HubSpot deal and org id (fastest)
- Time-limited promo code applied at signup (limited tracking)
- SOW addendum with a billed credit and explicit reporting (for legal / audit)

If you want the $3k / team top-up plus the upgraded bundle, the quickest path is to provision a promo credit on the org and tag it to the BrightLabs deal. Rishi / Marissa — can you confirm if finance needs a minimum cohort size or preapproval for $3k / team by vendor (BrightLabs)? Also copying Karthik for eligibility rules (incubators vs. open signups).

We can get you a formal confirmation and stub SOW by EOD Tuesday if that works.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Partnerships, Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai

Attachment: promo_guidelines.csv (internal)
From: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: BrightLabs cohort ask — pricing constraints and approval path

Vanessa / team — forwarding BrightLabs request. Quick notes:

- $3k / team is material if cohort size > 12. Need to know expected # of teams and whether BrightLabs will cap to a subset.
- We can do a one-time credit top-up but finance requires either (A) cohort roster and signed SOW tying credits to specific orgIDs or (B) a refundable deposit from the partner.
- For the embedding + generation bundle: recommend converting to a discounted reserved block if they expect sustained usage — cheaper for both sides and avoids open-ended promo spending.

Questions for BrightLabs: expected cohort size, whether credits are per-team or per-company, and whether founders can pool credits across teams. Also flagging that Legal may want to limit credits to 6 months.

If BrightLabs agrees to roster + SOW we can approve up to $2k / team without exec signoff; anything above that needs Marissa's OK. 

Rishi
Head of Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
From: Maria Chen <maria@brightlabs.org>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>, rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: BrightLabs Legal <legal@brightlabs.org>
Date: Wed, 26 Aug 2026 14:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: BrightLabs cohort ask — additional credits / pricing sweetener

Thanks, Rishi — and hi again Vanessa.

A quick update on numbers: cohort is 15 teams; BrightLabs wants to offer the full $3k / team but can cap the offer to the first 10 accepted teams if that makes approvals faster. Credits should be per-company (not pooled). Also 6-month expiry is acceptable to us.

If you can do $2k / team without exec signoff, can we get that provisioned now and then follow a simple SOW for the extra $1k for first-accepted-team carveout? We can sign the roster + SOW quickly — I'll put legal on standby.

Maria
From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2026 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: BrightLabs cohort ask — approval for $2k / team and follow-up SOW

Approving $2k / team for the first run given partner value and expected pipeline. Conditions:

- Credits valid for 6 months from issuance
- Cap to first 12 teams to limit exposure (BrightLabs offered 15; we accept 12)
- Roster + signed SOW required before provisioning credits
- Finance to set spend alert and tag HubSpot deal BL-2026-045

Vanessa — please confirm back to BrightLabs that we will provision $2k / team (max 12), and request a signed roster/SOW for the extra $1k carveout; Legal can take the SOW change after roster is received. Rishi / Karthik — please coordinate provisioning workflow and notify when credits are loaded so I can close the approval.

-Marissa
VP, Customer & Partner Growth, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
